cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Consequences Compound
cards.instruction: Make each new choice carry a larger reward, cost, audience, or point of no return.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Choose the biscuits carefully. The winning plate goes to the neighbourhood meeting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. It's also our first impression of the new committee.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then put your name beside the plate so we can test that publicly.
